claims: The 78th Primetime Emmy Awards are scheduled to air on NBC and Peacock on September 14, 2026.
The Emmy Awards cover Primetime, Daytime, News & Documentary, Sports, and International sectors.
The Emmy Awards recognize acting, writing, directing, and technical achievement.
Winners of the Emmy Awards are chosen by Television Academy members.
A video from Television Academy on YouTube dated Sep 14, 2025 shows the announcement of the winner for the Outstanding Supporting Actress in a Limited or Anthology Series or Movie.
Primetime Emmys honor primetime programming including Drama Series, Comedy Series, and Limited/Anthology Series.
Creative Arts Emmys focus on technical and artistic achievements including casting, sound, editing, and makeup.
Daytime Emmys recognize daytime programming including dramas, talk shows, and game shows.
International Emmys recognize excellence in TV produced outside the U.S.
Other specialized Emmy awards include News & Documentary, Sports, and Technology/Engineering Emmys.
Television Academy members consist of professionals in the industry.
The Emmy Awards selection process involves nominations by peers in specific categories followed by final voting.
The 78th Primetime Emmy Awards will be broadcast live coast-to-coast on NBC and via streaming on Peacock on Monday, September 14, 2026.
